workflow.title: Underground Storage Tank Registration & Compliance
workflow.description: Connecticut regulatory, registration, operating, testing, operator, financial-responsibility, status, and administrative closure resources for existing regulated UST systems.

relationships.workflow_note: Review current Connecticut program updates, notification pathways, release-prevention information, closure resources, and ezFile instructions for regulated UST systems.
Consult the controlling Connecticut requirements for applicability, operation, testing, release detection, operators, financial responsibility, status changes, closure, notification, and records.
Use as the maintained professional hub for current notification, inspection, testing, operator, financial-responsibility, closure, and suspected-release materials.
Review current and historical facility and tank records and compare the state dataset with the owner or operator's facility information and notification history.
Open the current CT DEEP table when identifying the testing provisions that may be relevant to a tank system or component.
Use to locate Connecticut operator requirements, approved Class A/B courses and exams, Class C information, and current training-submission resources.
Review Connecticut's current financial-responsibility guidance, recognized mechanisms, notification relationship, and program contacts.
